requirements.title: Choose a business structure — sole proprietorship
requirements.evidence: You’ll need to choose a business structure before you register your business with the state.
requirements.why: You have one owner and chose sole proprietorship. This is the simplest form for testing a low-risk idea. You are automatically a sole proprietorship when you do business without registering another form.
requirements.background: You will work for yourself with no partners, so you are a sole proprietorship by default and should plan as one.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote only says to choose a structure before registering and does not show that you are automatically a sole proprietorship or that it is the simplest form.

requirements.title: Register Fernline Studio as an Oregon Assumed Business Name
requirements.evidence: Registering your DBA name doesn’t provide legal protection by itself, but most states require you to register your DBA if you use one.
requirements.why: You will do business as Fernline Studio, which is not your own legal name. A DBA, also called a trade name or assumed name, usually must be registered with the state when you use one.
requirements.background: You will use Fernline Studio instead of your own legal name, and Oregon generally requires registration of a name like that.
problems: Only federal pages were cited for a state requirement

requirements.title: Get a federal EIN if you want one for taxes and banking
requirements.evidence: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
requirements.why: You are a sole proprietor with no employees and not a corporation or partnership, so you are not required to have an EIN. An EIN, which means Employer Identification Number, is free and can help open a business bank account.
problems: Fee not found in the quote

requirements.title: File yearly federal income tax and pay self-employment tax
requirements.evidence: Self-employed individuals generally must pay self-employment (SE) tax as well as income tax.
requirements.why: You will earn self-employment income as a freelance designer. Self-employment tax means Social Security and Medicare taxes for people who work for themselves.
requirements.background: Freelance design pay counts as self employment income, which must be reported on a yearly federal return with Social Security and Medicare taxes.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote says self-employed people must pay income and SE tax but does not show that SE tax means Social Security and Medicare taxes.

requirements.title: Pay federal estimated taxes each quarter if you will owe enough
conditions: Will you owe $1,000 or more in federal tax for the year?
requirements.evidence: Individuals, including sole proprietors, partners, and S corporation shareholders, generally must make estimated tax payments if they expect to owe tax of $1,000 or more when their return is filed.
requirements.why: You will have no employer withholding tax from design pay. Estimated tax is how self-employed people prepay income plus Social Security and Medicare taxes during the year.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote shows the $1,000 threshold but does not show that payments are each quarter or that estimated tax prepays income plus Social Security and Medicare taxes.

requirements.title: Pay Oregon personal income tax on business earnings
requirements.why: You live and work in Oregon as a sole proprietor. Oregon taxes personal income, so design profits are usually taxed on your personal return.
requirements.background: Oregon taxes the earnings of residents who work for themselves, so your design profits are generally taxed on your state personal return.

requirements.title: Check the federal trademark database for Fernline Studio
requirements.agency: United States Patent and Trademark Office
requirements.evidence: A trademark can protect the name of your business, goods, and services at a national level.
requirements.why: You will use Fernline Studio online for logos and social graphics. A trademark gives national protection for a business name and can avoid costly infringement fights.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote says a trademark can protect a business name nationally but does not show any requirement to check the federal trademark database.

requirements.title: Register a website domain name for the studio
requirements.evidence: Once you register your domain name, no one else can use it for as long as you continue to own it.
requirements.why: You plan to find clients through your own website and social media. A domain name, which means your website address, protects your online brand.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote says a registered domain cannot be used by others while you own it but does not show that you must register a domain name.

requirements.title: Register for a Portland Revenue Division tax account
requirements.evidence: Businesses that are subject to the Portland Business License Tax, Portland Transient Lodgings Tax, Multnomah County Business Income Tax, and/or the Metro Supportive Housing Services (SHS) Business Income Tax are required to register for a Revenue Division tax account. The City of Portland collects the MCBIT on behalf of Multnomah County.
requirements.why: You live and work in Portland in Multnomah County and will earn design income from home. The city runs the tax account system for Portland and county business taxes.
requirements.background: You will do design work from home in Portland, and new businesses must register with the city and county tax system.
problems: Quote not found on the cited pages

requirements.title: File and pay Multnomah County Business Income Tax
requirements.agency: City of Portland Revenue Division on behalf of Multnomah County
requirements.deadline: at the same time they file their federal and state income tax returns
requirements.evidence: Businesses with apportionable income in Multnomah County are subject to the Multnomah Count Business Income Tax. Taxfilers must file their business tax returns and pay their business tax liability at the same time they file their federal and state income tax returns.
requirements.why: You will have design income tied to your home in Multnomah County. County income from business in the county is subject to this county tax.

requirements.title: File and pay Portland Business License Tax
requirements.evidence: Businesses that are subject to the Portland Business License Tax, Portland Transient Lodgings Tax, Multnomah County Business Income Tax, and/or the Metro Supportive Housing Services (SHS) Business Income Tax are required to register for a Revenue Division tax account.
requirements.why: You work from home inside Portland city limits and will sell design services. Businesses subject to the Portland Business License Tax use the same city tax account system.
requirements.background: You will sell design services from home inside Portland, so you are doing business in the city covered by this tax.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote only says certain businesses must register for an account and does not show that this home design business is subject or must file and pay.

requirements.title: Follow Portland Type A home occupation rules - no permit needed
requirements.agency: Portland Permitting and Development, Property Compliance
requirements.evidence: A Type A home occupation is one where residents use their home as a place of work; however, no employees or customers/clients come to the site. No permit is required.
requirements.why: You will work from a home office in Portland with one owner, no hiring now, and no customers visiting. That matches the city's Type A home work with no site visits.

requirements.title: Get Portland Type B home permit if helper or customers come to home
requirements.agency: Portland Permitting and Development, Property Compliance
conditions: Will customers or a non-resident helper come to your home for work?
requirements.evidence: A Type B home occupation is one where the residents use their home as a place of work, and allows one non-resident employee (business partner, co-owner, or other person affiliated with the business who does not reside at the site) per shift and up to 15 customers/clients per day come to the site. A $223.00 non-refundable application fee is required for a 2-year permit.
requirements.why: You now say no one will come to the home, so you do not need this. If you later have a helper or clients visit the home, the city requires a Type B permit.

requirements.title: File Multnomah County business personal property return if required
conditions: Will you have business computers, furniture, or tools worth more than a few thousand dollars?
requirements.why: You will run a design studio from home with a computer and office setup. Counties often tax business furniture and gear, so this yearly return may apply.

requirements.title: No Oregon state sales tax on freelance graphic design services
requirements.agency: General Services Administration, Office of GSA IT
requirements.evidence: The state does not have a sales tax; however, Oregon may impose a State Transient Lodging Tax for hotel stays.
requirements.why: Fernline Studio sells logo and graphic design services online only, not hotel stays, and Oregon has no general state sales tax.

openQuestions.question: Our search for official pages about tax returns and renewals after opening in Oregon didn’t finish. Re-check later, or ask.
openQuestions.answer: Our pages did not cover renewals and later returns, so this cannot be settled now. The city revenue office and state filing guides would settle it.

openQuestions.question: What is the current form, fee, and renewal period to register Fernline Studio as an Oregon Assumed Business Name?
openQuestions.answer: The pages provided do not show the current filing details for an assumed name. The Secretary of State business name office would settle it.

openQuestions.question: Does this sole proprietorship need a separate Oregon state tax account, or does it report earnings on the owner's personal tax return?
openQuestions.answer: As a sole proprietor with no hiring plans, you generally report business earnings on your own personal state return. You do not need a separate state business income tax account for that income.

openQuestions.question: What are the current minimum income limits and filing rules for Portland and Multnomah County business taxes for a sole proprietor making under $25,000?
openQuestions.answer: The pages confirm registration and a tax on doing business but do not state current low income filing limits. Ask the Revenue Division whether earnings at your level must file and pay.

openQuestions.question: Does a home graphic design studio with only online clients need any other city or county license beyond the tax account?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing in the pages shows another city or county license for online design work from home. The tax account registration appears to be the city business license step for you.

openQuestions.question: What is the current filing limit for business personal property in Multnomah County for home office computers and furniture?
openQuestions.answer: None of the pages state the county rule for home office items like computers and furniture. The county property assessment office would settle whether you must list them.

openQuestions.question: What is the current Type B home occupation fee, wait time, and inspection rule if a helper or customer later comes to the home?
openQuestions.answer: You now work alone online with no visitors, so no home occupation permit is shown as needed. If a helper or customer later comes to the home, check with city permitting first.

conflicts.about: How many customers can come to a Portland home under a home occupation permit
conflicts.explanation: One city page says Type B allows up to 15 customers or clients per day, while another city page says you may get a home occupation permit if up to eight customers per day come to your home. It is unclear which daily limit applies to you if you later have home visits.
